# v0.19.0: what a relay's screen says about an offer, per server state.
#
# Both halves read this file. The server (server/brain/jobs.py OFFER_TEXT) is the only
# source of the state; the phone (core/RelayOffersView.kt) shows exactly the text on the
# same line and nothing else. The product rule (contract §4): a pending job is never
# spendable cash - "Vérifié — gagné" is said only for a block or a move the Brain verified
# and settled; anything it did not verify reads "Non vérifié — rien gagné".
#
# One STATE|text per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

OFFERED|Proposé
ACCEPTED|Accepté — en attente
IN_PROGRESS|En cours
COMPLETED|Vérifié — gagné
DECLINED|Refusé
CANCELLED|Annulé
EXPIRED|Expiré
FAILED|Non vérifié — rien gagné
